name: DMD 5530
title: 3D Virtual World and Simulations
description: Students are challenged to design and develop a virtual simulation that will train, educate or replicate a historical, military or scientific event. Participants investigate a selection of different virtual environments, simulations and serious games, explore some of the basic principles of 3D modeling, and examine how game engines can be used to generate a three-dimensional computer-based environment.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
